summary: A clerk looks up {building} in the hotel schedule even when every listed category has the same rate.
realLife: New York City's 2025 hotel order listed residential apartment hotels, lodging houses, smaller Class B rooming houses, Class B hotels and SRO buildings, allowing no guideline increase in any category.
gates: The case record identifies the covered building classification and hotel order.
